The '''1989–90 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 54th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 17 September 1989 and ended on 27 May 1990. [[Panathinaikos F.C.|Panathinaikos]] won their 15th Greek title and their first one in four years.

The point system was: ''Win: 2 points'' - ''Draw: 1 point''.
